text.p: These are the main stories reported in the Angolan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The process to demobilise child soldiers from the former rebel UNITA movement began in Huambo province on Tuesday in terms of a peace accord between the Angolan government and UNITA to end two decades of civil war.
- United States President Bill Clinton has said in a report to Congress he is against lifting sanctions against UNITA enforced in 1993.
- Portugal's chief of staff Octavio Cerqueira Rocha is due to arrive in Angola on Wednesday to prepare for a visit by Portugal Defence Minister Antonio Vitorino from Monday.
- The commander for the United States military for Europe, General James Jamerson is in Luanda for talks with the Angolan Armed Forces.
